newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus firms on H1 profit news.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus firms on H1 profit news.

text.p: Shares in French pay-television station Canal Plus firmed sharply on news it would post a higher first-half net attributable profit of 386 million francs from 331 million a year ago.
The stock rose 28 francs to a day-high of 1,219 francs before giving back some of the gains. The share had been trading 12 francs higher at 1,207 just before the news.

A source close to the company told Reuters that Canal Plus would report the higher profit figure for the first half and that the full-year profit would be at least equal to 1995. The company declined comment.
